caption: The drawing depicts an interior scene furnished in a retro style, featuring several large, curved, beige and maroon couches arranged around a round glass coffee table at the center. The floor is covered in a patterned green and black tile. On the left wall, there is a black rotary payphone and a wooden shelf holding a book and a notepad, as well as two pin-up style posters of women, one in color and one in black and white. A colorful jukebox with illuminated sides stands below the posters. To the right of the jukebox, bar stools are grouped around a counter, with boxes and a candy machine nearby. In the background, there are sections labeled “Nuts,” “Candy,” and “Cocktails,” with a pink neon sign for “Cocktails” above. Three large mirrors are mounted on the back wall, reflecting the booths and a window. The ceiling is beige and gray and features rectangular acoustic tiles and a pattern of yellow squiggly lines, with fluorescent light fixtures hanging down. On the right, above one of the booths, is a poster advertising “Atom Bomb” with a pin-up woman, and a candy vending machine is visible close to the foreground. The coffee table in front holds a tray with a shaker and glasses. A low brown table in the front right displays some scattered objects next to an open book or magazine with illegible writing. The color palette consists mainly of beige, maroon, green, yellow, and pale brown, with bright accents from the jukebox and posters.
title: Cocktail Lounge, 1946
